notes.text: Use only the Steam Corrupted Compendium (3705392682, pack MiaoYingCorrupted_Compendium_workshop.pack) and delete the LoversLab MiaoYingCorrupted_Compendium.pack from the data folder. The 'workshop fix' upload (3754256443) is obsolete. Azazel's Realm's @@Compendium_Play_as_Azazel_Overwrite.pack (only needed when playing anyone but Miao) still expects the LoversLab file name and crashes at startup with the Steam version (reported 2026-10-22); renaming fixes the crash but breaks the Ensign Loi dependency.
